items.title: Body cam footage could overload the justice system, warns senior Crown prosecutor
items.summary_auto: Body cameras can be a valuable source of evidence for the justice system, but it gives legal professionals a lot of extra footage to review. The head of the province’s Crown Attorney Association says there’s not enough resources for prosecutors to process body camera footage.
